blocks.x: Cloud, Edge & Platform, tuned for Medical Devices & MedTech: sector-specific design decisions, the delivery pattern with named owners, and outcomes gated on signed metrics.

MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

Governance inherits the sector frame — EU MDR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Reliability as product: SLOs, error budgets and incident discipline that engineers actually follow.
Golden paths, paved roads: an internal platform that turns months into days.
Cost and carbon as engineering metrics: unit economics, showback and green compute by design.

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: tiered DICOM archives with cost telemetry (storage unit cost down 30-40%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
